result: With six years of experience as a data analyst, I have built my career on turning complex operational data into decisions that improve people's daily lives. That focus is what draws me to the Portland transit department. In my most recent role, I led an analysis of service patterns and schedule adherence to understand why buses were arriving in clusters, leaving riders with long waits followed by crowded vehicles. By combining GPS location data, dwell times, and rider feedback, I identified the stops and time periods where bunching was most severe and recommended targeted adjustments to scheduling and dispatch practices. After implementation, bunching-related complaints dropped by 18 percent. Beyond the numbers, I am proud that the project gave frontline staff clear, accessible dashboards they could use every day. I would welcome the chance to bring the same blend of technical rigor, collaboration, and rider-focused thinking to Portland's transit system and help make service more reliable for the community.
